rundown: Nuggets beat Pelicans 116-108 at Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, LA in front of 15,721. Nuggets led 56-51 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Nuggets won it 29-23. By ESPN's win probability it was never really in doubt (never below 77%).
Leading the way — Nuggets: Nikola Jokic 26 pts, 10 ast, 8 reb. Pelicans: Zion Williamson 24 pts; Jeremiah Fears 7 ast; Yves Missi 8 reb.
Where Nuggets won it: they shot 53% to 42%, won the boards 47-38 and had 29 assists to 25.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Nuggets closed as 12.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (Pelicans +12.5 cashed); the total closed at 235.5 and they combined for 224, under by 11.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 6:59 PM ET. It had Nuggets 93% and Pelicans 7%, projecting Nuggets 128.2 – Pelicans 111 (239.2 total, Nuggets by 17.3).

Final: Nuggets 116 – Pelicans 108. Right winner: it had Nuggets at 93%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Nuggets came in with a 3% above average attack and a league-average defense (6-4, 114.5 scored and 113.3 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 66 and 66 games of evidence. Projected to score 128.2, they scored 116 (−12.2 points, 10% under); projected to allow 111, they allowed 108 (−3 points, 3% under).

Pelicans came in with a league-average attack and a 5% leakier than average defense (4-9, 116.5 scored and 125.6 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 81 and 80 games of evidence. Projected to score 111, they scored 108 (−3 points, 3% under); projected to allow 128.2, they allowed 116 (−12.2 points, 10% under).

The bigger miss was Nuggets' scoring (-12.2 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 224 against 239.2 projected (-15.2), about the 20th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: Nuggets by 8 against Nuggets by 17.3 projected, about the 78th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): Pelicans ×1.00, Nuggets ×1.02. It favored Nuggets, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
NO ML (+470) at +470: the algo gave it 15% vs 17% fair (-1.4 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 17%). DEN ML (-650) at -650: the algo gave it 85% vs 83% fair (+1.4 pts) — won (+0.2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 83%). NO +12.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 49% vs 51% fair (-1.8 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. DEN -12.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+1.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 235.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.9 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 235.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.9 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 74% of bets on Nuggets, 63% of the money — Pelicans covered; total: 68% of bets on the over, 70% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 95% of bets on Nuggets, 92% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Nuggets, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.931 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +9.9 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 77 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.993 and gives home teams +0.6 points. Team corrections so far: Nuggets attack ×0.997, defense ×0.987 (5 games); Pelicans attack ×0.979, defense ×1.036 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
